defect: The new pointer handlers pass the raw Windows PointerId as the touch id, which on mobile Windows 10 is a large arbitrary number, so touch ids overflow the small-index assumptions (1 << input.id, MAX_POINTERS) of the UI and touch input breaks.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added raw PointerId uses with a TouchMapper slot index (and drops pointer capture on ARM), repairing broken touch on mobile in lines this change added.

defect: The fix adds a TouchMapper class and member to App.h to map pointer ids to touch slots; the header created here contains no faulty code.
reason: The touch-id defect lies in the pointer handlers added to App.cpp by a later commit; this header change only gets new declarations and brace style edits.

defect: The new vrnd_generate computes the E increment with a guessed chain of addition_overflows tests that does not match the PSP hardware RNG sequence.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added E formula with the carry of C + D/2 + E, correcting the generated values; only hardware test data reveals the mismatch.

defect: The fix makes IsRunningSlow compare against the display refresh rate / 1.001 instead of the hard-coded 58.94, removing a discarded expression statement.
reason: The no-op System_GetPropertyInt expression and the hard-coded threshold already existed before this change, which only moved the no-op line above the loop.

defect: The new sceGeListEnqueue check rejects lists when args->size >= 256 instead of checking args->numStacks, so it tests the wrong field of PspGeListArgs.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added condition to args->numStacks (issue #11660, mistranslation from jpcsp), so the wrong check came from this change.

defect: The fix moves the 'VFPv4 implies IDIVa/IDIVt' workaround for buggy Qualcomm kernels from Summarize into Detect so the flags themselves are set.
reason: Reading idiva/idivt from /proc/cpuinfo as written here is correct; the fix is a workaround for kernels that under-report features (missed optimisation, not a defect of this change).

defect: In the new WriteStoreOp the break for TYPE_REG/TYPE_IMMSREG sits inside if (!SpecialOp), so register-offset halfword/signed loads and stores fall through to the default case and emit BKPT instead of the instruction.
reason: The fix moves exactly this break out of the if, and the misplaced break in the added switch is visible in the diff (the op table even lists register encodings for these ops).

defect: The fix re-hides the Vertex Decoder JIT checkbox that this change exposed for debugging, and adds a Fast Memory option.
reason: Showing or hiding a settings checkbox is a deliberate UI/configuration choice, not a defect.

defect: The fix inverts the test so that textures are left unscaled when they ARE frequently changing (STATUS_CHANGE_FREQUENT != 0) instead of when they are not.
reason: The inverted '== 0' condition was introduced earlier the same day by 6129af9 and already existed before this change, which only wrapped it in braces and added a STATUS_TO_SCALE mark.

defect: The fix implements half-way buffer mode in the new Atrac2 (RemainingFrames, AddStreamData state transition and size check, GetStreamDataInfo), which this work-in-progress commit left as a fallback.
reason: This commit is an early step of an unfinished, developer-setting-only reimplementation (decoder call still commented out) and half-way buffering did not work before it either; the fix continues the feature work.

defect: The fix only extends the comment on streamDataByte to note it is not decremented per block in half-way mode.
reason: Both the change and the fix touch only a comment in this header; there is no code defect here.

defect: In this file the fix only makes generation of the static-register save/load stubs conditional on a new jo.useStaticAlloc option and turns the debug disassembly dump back off.
reason: The stubs generated unconditionally are harmless and the always-on disassembly log is debug noise; the real static-alloc bugs the fix repairs (dirty static regs keeping ML_ARMREG_IMM, sanity check) are in Arm64RegCache.cpp.

defect: The fix repairs the later static-allocation code (dirty mapping of a static register keeping its stale imm, FlushAll sanity check, allocation order gating by useStaticAlloc).
reason: All repaired logic (isStatic handling, GetStaticAllocations) was added by later static-alloc commits; the one original line touched, the FlushAll sanity check, was correct before static registers existed.

defect: The fix bounds-checks currentTab in CurrentTabHandle so an early tab-control notify under wine no longer indexes an empty tabs vector.
reason: CurrentTabHandle was already an unchecked index before this change (tabs[TabCtrl_GetCurSel()], which is -1 with no tabs), and the crashing call from ShowTab was added later by 54f5405.

defect: The new robustness check skips every relocation whose target address is not 4-byte aligned ((addr & 3)), although misaligned relocations are legal in PSP binaries, so valid relocations are silently dropped.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added alignment condition; knowing that misaligned relocations occur needs PSP/ELF knowledge, not the diff.

defect: The new Replay_Unload sets g_opToExec to Done and notifies opFinishWait, but the replay thread waits on the predicate g_opDone, which stays false, so the thread never wakes and replayThread.join() hangs when exiting while paused inside a display list.
reason: The fix replaces this added wake-up with a g_cancelled flag checked in the wait predicate and the command loop; the predicate mismatch is visible in the diff context of ExecuteOnMain.

defect: The fix only shortens two WARN_LOG messages (drops 'fake success' wording).
reason: Log text is not a defect; behaviour is unchanged.

defect: The fix only moves loop braces onto the for lines and adds a space, a style cleanup.
reason: Pure formatting change with no behavioural effect.

defect: In this file the fix only rewords framebuffer-matching log messages (adds addresses, fixes '% s'/'% d' spacing, rewords 'fb_format not supported').
reason: The rename of VirtualFramebuffer::format to fb_format is behaviour-neutral; the only fallout is awkward log wording, and the malformed '% s' format came from a later commit.

defect: The new Spongebob depth-fail special case passes GL_ADD (a texture-environment constant) instead of GL_FUNC_ADD as the blend equations to SetBlendAndMask, giving an invalid blend equation.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added GL_ADD arguments with GL_FUNC_ADD; the wrong enum is visible in the added line.

defect: The change passes exp, a PostfixExpression object, to sprintf's %s instead of the C string str, which is undefined behaviour and prints garbage or crashes when the size expression fails to parse.
reason: The fix reverts exactly this changed argument back to str; the mismatch is visible from the diff (exp is the compiled expression filled by initExpression).

defect: The new Symbian AllocateExecutableMemory hands out blocks from an RChunk heap (Alloc per call), but the JIT still releases code space through the munmap-based free path, so returning to the menu frees heap memory the wrong way and crashes.
reason: The fix reworks exactly this added allocation (allocate once, then return the heap base, never free on Symbian, with the free disabled in ArmEmitter.h); seeing the mismatch requires the code-space free path in ArmEmitter.h.

defect: The newly added FCmp case for IRFpCompareMode::NotEqualUnordered computes a != b, but IRCompFPU maps the MIPS c.un (unordered only) compare to this mode, so fpcond is set for any unequal pair instead of only when an operand is NaN.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added case with a true unordered test (!(a>b || a<b || a==b)); seeing that the mode stands for c.un needs IRCompFPU.cpp.

defect: The new branch in EmuScreen::touch drops every non-up touch event whenever mouse control is enabled, including genuine touchscreen input, instead of only mouse-generated events.
reason: The fix narrows exactly this added condition with TOUCH_MOUSE; the over-broad filter is visible in the added line, whose comment speaks only of the hidden mouse pointer.

defect: The fix adds the override specifier to the SetViewport2D declaration.
reason: Adding override is a style/warning cleanup; the declaration added here behaves the same with or without it.

defect: The fix adds the override specifier to the SetViewport2D and MakePixelTexture declarations.
reason: Adding override is a style/warning cleanup with no behavioural effect.

defect: In this header the fix only gives TextureFilter and TextureAddressMode enumerators explicit values equal to their implicit ones.
reason: Adding explicit values identical to the implicit ones changes nothing; the enum moves and stencil additions of this change are correct.

defect: The fix overhauls GL texture/sampler handling: corrects the inverted canWrap_ test, applies samplers per bound texture, maps GLES2 border clamp to CLAMP_TO_EDGE, binds explicitly and uses target_ instead of GL_TEXTURE_2D.
reason: The real bugs fixed (inverted canWrap_, sampler application, GLES2 wrap table) predate this refactor, which only moved the constructor out of line; its added GL_TEXTURE_2D parameter calls act on the texture SetImageData just bound, and only 2D targets are supported.

defect: The new GetFilesList reads the number of file entries from fileListAddr+12 instead of +0, so for games where the two fields differ the file list is processed with the wrong count and save loading fails (God Eater Burst, Gundam VS Gundam NP).
reason: The fix changes exactly this added offset to +0; which field holds the count is PSP structure knowledge not visible in the code (the comment says both held 5 in the tested game).

defect: The fix makes Config::Load fall back to ppsspp.ini/controls.ini when passed NULL file names and logs/loads via the stored member strings, alongside a new --config/--controlconfig command-line feature.
reason: Both parameters have non-NULL defaults and no caller passes NULL, so storing controllerIniFilename here cannot crash; the NULL fallback is defensive hardening accompanying a feature.

defect: The fix adds parsing of --config= and --controlconfig= options and passes the resulting file names to g_Config.Load.
reason: This is a new feature; the earlier g_Config.Load() call that this change moved before argument parsing is not wrong.

defect: The fix stops the new 'unexpected bufw' ERROR_LOG_REPORT from firing for kernel (PPGe) textures, which legitimately use wider buffer widths.
reason: The added check only produced spurious log/report messages; texture decoding itself was unaffected, so the fix is a diagnostics cleanup rather than a repair of wrong behaviour.

defect: The fix bumps the GL shader cache version from 4 to 5 after a later shader ID change.
reason: Bumping the version to 4 was correct here; the next bump is needed because of a later change to shader ID computation, not because of this commit.

defect: When moving the texel decoders into Colors.h, DecodeRGBA4444 was rewritten to take red from bits 12-15 and alpha from bits 0-3, reversing the channel order of the previously correct Rasterizer.cpp version.
reason: The fix restores r/g/b/a to bits 0/4/8/12 in exactly this added function; the reversal is visible in the diff, since the 5551/565 decoders and RGBA8888To4444 in the same file put red in the low bits.

defect: The rewritten delete-button condition uses the same ternary as the select branch (CTRL_CROSS when preference is not circle, else CTRL_CIRCLE) instead of the opposite button, so the delete branch is unreachable and the OSK delete button no longer works.
reason: The fix swaps exactly this added ternary to CTRL_CIRCLE : CTRL_CROSS; the copy-paste duplication of the select condition is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adds a compileBlocked_ flag so pipeline creation is refused while the compile queue is drained at shutdown, and moves the pipeline allocation after the missing-shader check.
reason: The 'delete pipeline' added here correctly plugs the leak; the shutdown race the fix targets is unrelated to this change, and moving the allocation is only a tidy-up.

defect: The fix turns DrainCompileQueue into DrainAndBlockCompileQueue/ReleaseCompileQueue so no new pipelines are queued between draining and shader-manager cleanup.
reason: This change only made DrainCompileQueue public for a precautionary drain; the shutdown race with the compile thread existed before it (with no drain at all), so the fix hardens pre-existing behaviour.

defect: The new loop in PerformDeletes destroys buffersWithAllocs_ but then clears buffers_ instead of buffersWithAllocs_, so the VMA buffers stay in the list and are destroyed again on the next PerformDeletes (double free); Take() also never moves the new list.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added clear() to buffersWithAllocs_.clear() and adds the list to Take(); the copy-paste slip is visible in the added lines.

defect: The fix makes keymap loading fall back to defaults when controls.ini is missing and always writes the keymap on save, plus a brace-style change on Config::Save.
reason: The keymap load/save logic it repairs was written by the later f1bc751 control-map commit; this change only renamed CConfig to Config and added recent-ISO handling, and the touched Save signature line is merely restyled.

defect: The new CLUT lookup masks the index with 0xE before OR-ing the start position, discarding bit 0 and all bits above 3, so CLUT8/CLUT4 textures read the wrong palette entries.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added '& 0xE' with '& 0xFF' ('critical bug'); masking an 8-bit index with 0xE is visibly wrong in the diff.
